title: Purple Skull Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a stylized male character with white skin, purple and black horns, and a skull motif. He wears ornate purple and white armor with skull decorations, flowing purple sashes, and performs dynamic fighting stances against a plain gray background.
prompt: A demonic male warrior with pale white skin, glowing eyes, large curved purple and black horns, and wild white hair. He wears intricate purple and off-white armor with multiple skull decorations, a wide black belt, flowing purple sashes, and black sandals. Shown in four different dynamic fighting poses including punching, blocking, and striking, all on a solid gray background, anime influenced digital illustration style
